source: 726 Fragment of Fate
target: 726 Fragmentum Fati

source: Roselle Gustav in the mirror?
target: Roselle Gustav in speculo?

source: When Franca, Jenna, and Anthony heard that the name of this dazzling figure, revered by every Intisian, was connected to the Mirror People, their minds went completely blank.
target: Cum Franca, Jenna, et Anthony audirent nomen huius fulgidæ figurae, ab omni Intisiano veneratæ, ad Populum Speculi pertinere, mentes eorum omnino vacuae factæ sunt.

source: They instinctively wanted to question him further, but Moran Avigny’s reaction and change in expression appeared to validate Lumian’s conjecture.
target: Instinctu veluti eum amplius interrogare velle conabantur, sed responsio et mutatio vultus Moran Avigny coniecturam Lumiani videbantur confirmare.

source: “But the Emperor has been dead for over a century. How can there still be a corresponding Mirror Person?” Franca asked, finally composing herself.
target: "Sed imperator iam centum annos et ultra mortuus est. Quomodo adhuc persona speculi correspondens esse possit?" inquit Franca, tandem se componens.

source: It made sense that Emperor Roselle would have encountered Trier’s underground corruption.
target: Rationabile erat quod imperator Roselle corruptionem subterraneam Trieris occurrisset.

source: He had, after all, lived in Trier for an extended period after reaching adulthood, and he was not one to easily settle down.
target: Postquam ad aetatem adultam pervenit, in Trier per longum tempus vixit, et non erat is qui facile se constituere solebat.

source: Lumian’s serious expression softened a bit.
target: Vultus severus Lumiani paulum mollitus est.

source: “Initially, I hesitated to make that guess, but then I recalled something. For someone of Emperor Roselle’s stature, even if they perish, they might not be completely gone. There could even be a possibility of resurrection.”
target: "Initio coniecturam facere dubitabam, sed deinde aliquid recordatus sum.

source: It was just like Naboredisley’s Abomination corpse resting in the ancient tomb of the Dream Festival.
target: Id erat, sicut corpus abominationis Naboredisley quiescens in sepulcro antiquo Festi Somniorum.

source: Franca made an odd remark.
target: Franca rem insolitam enuntiavit.

source: “Old institutions are hard to get rid of…”
target: "Vetera instituta aboli difficilia sunt…"

source: With their experience dealing with the Devil Monarch’s Abomination corpse, Franca, Jenna, and Anthony quickly accepted Lumian’s explanation.
target: Experientia habita cum corpore abominationis Diaboli Monarchi versantes, Franca, Jenna, et Anthony celeriter expositionem Lumiani acceperunt.

source: Lumian looked at Moran Avigny, whose face had turned ashen, and smiled.
target: Lumian ad Moran Avigny aspiciens, cuius vultus in cinerem conversus erat, subridit.

source: “I made a bold hypothesis and meticulously verified it. When I shared my guess with him, he willingly confirmed it.”
target: "Audacem hypothesim proposui et diligenter confirmavi.

source: Moran Avigny’s lips trembled, wanting to defend himself, but he held back.
target: Labia Moran Avigny tremebant, se defendere velle, sed abstinuit.

source: He believed that the more he tried to explain, the more he would end up helping these people.
target: Credidit quod, quo magis explicare conaretur, eo magis eos adiuvaret.

source: His urge to confide led him to add, “Now, do you understand that our Mirror People are also incredibly powerful?
target: Eius impetus confidendi duxit eum ad addendum dicens, "Nuncne intellegitis quod homines speculi nostri etiam incredibiliter potentes sint?"

source: “If we can fully break the seal of Fourth Epoch Trier, we will be as strong as any orthodox Church!”
target: "Si sigillum Triorum Quarti Æpoci penitus perrumpere poterimus, tam validi erimus quam quaelibet Ecclesia orthodoxa!"

source: Franca disregarded Moran Avigny’s showy remark and muttered to herself, “No wonder the Church’s demigods refuse to personally go underground and resolve the various abnormalities here unless the seal of Fourth Epoch Trier is badly damaged.
target: Franca rem ostentatam Moran Avigny neglexit et sibi submurmuravit: "Non mirum est quod demigodi Ecclesiae recusant personaliter in subterraneum ire et hic varias anomalias solvere, nisi sigillum Triorum Quarti Æpoci grave laesum sit."

source: “This isn’t about fixing abnormalities. It’s about making more of them!”
target: "Hoc non ad corrigendas anomalias pertinet, sed ad eas multiplicandas!"

source: Even though the demigods of the Eternal Blazing Sun Church didn’t have to fear the birth of their corresponding Mirror People, Trier’s underground corruption extended beyond just the mirror world!
target: Etsi demigodi Ecclesiae Solis Aeterni Ardoris non timere debuerunt ortum suorum specularum, corruptiones subterraneae Trieris ultra mundum speculi patebant!

source: Isn’t the underground of Trier excessively vile and horrifying?
target: Nonne subterraneum Trieris nimis foedum et terribile est?

source: This was assuming that Fourth Epoch Trier was relatively well-sealed.
target: Assumendum est quod Trier Quarti Æpoci relative bene sigillatum esset.

source: What had the four Emperors, particularly Blood Emperor Alista Tudor, done during the War of the Four Emperors?
target: Quid quattuor Imperatores, praesertim Imperator Sanguineus Alista Tudor, in Bello Quattuor Imperatorum egerunt?

source: The issues they left behind more than a thousand years ago were still incredibly terrifying!
target: Quaestiones, quas ante plus quam mille annos reliquerunt, adhuc incredibiliter terribiles erant!

source: We often venture into Trier’s underground and have even entered Fourth Epoch Trier and the unique mirror world.
target: Saepe in subterranea Trieris iter facimus et etiam in Trier Quarti Æpoci atque in singularem mundum speculi intravimus.

source: Could there be a corresponding special Mirror Person?
target: Poteratne exsistere persona speculi specialis correspondens?

source: No, it’s not a matter of whether there is one, but rather that there definitely was one. They had encountered it before!
target: Non, non quaestio est utrum sit, sed certe fuit; iam ante eam convenerant!

source: Lumian ignored Moran Avigny’s boasting and turned to Jenna.
target: Lumian ostentationem Moran Avigny neglexit et ad Jenna se vertit.

source: “Our investigation into the Mirror People has yielded significant progress. Combined with the Overseer, who evidently possesses godhood, what unfolds next is beyond our ability to intervene. As soon as we acquire the coordinates of the Overseer’s mirror, promptly report the entire situation.”
target: "Investigatio nostra de Populo Speculi progressum significativum attulit.

source: Jenna curtly acknowledged his words and laughed self-deprecatingly.
target: Jenna verba eius brevi modo agnovit et sibi ipsi, cum humilitate, risit.

source: “Actually, I’m dying to report it now.”
target: "Revera, nunc morior ex desiderio ut id referam."

source: From her viewpoint, although she was unsure why the School of Truth was searching for Emperor Roselle’s final mausoleum or what their intentions were, given the strong probability that they had already obtained vital information and collaborated with the mirror Roselle, the situation had obviously become very urgent, and it was certainly not a positive development.
target: Ex eius prospectu, quamquam nescia erat cur Schola Veritatis mausoleum finalem Imperatoris Roselle quaereret aut quid consilia haberet, cum magna probabilitate iam informationes vitales adepti essent et cum speculo Roselle collaboraverint, res manifeste valde urgentissimae factae erant, nec certe progressus favorabilis erat.

source: “You can begin writing now.” Lumian gave a slight nod and shifted his gaze to Moran Avigny.
target: "Nun scribere potes," inquit Lumian, leviter annuens et oculos ad Moran Avigny convertens.

source: He planned to appropriate the other party’s fate.
target: Consilium ceperat fatum partis adversæ sibi appropriandi.

source: Fate Appropriation was not his objective. By seizing the chance to interact with fate, his aim was to seek essential information from past fate fragments.
target: Fatum appropriationem non erat propositum eius. Occasione cum fato interagendi captâ, propositum eius fuit informationes esenciales ex fragmentis fati praeteritorum quaerere.

source: This was the penultimate segment of the “interrogation.”
target: Hoc fuit penultima pars "interrogationis".

source: The final segment involved spirit channeling to forcibly obtain the coordinates of the Overseer’s mirror!
target: Ultima pars ad canalizationem spiritus pertinebat, qua vi coordinatas speculi Supervisoris obtinere conabatur!

source: Furthermore, Lumian wanted to take this opportunity to observe what would happen to the target if he seized one of their fate fragments without exchanging fates or directly causing their death.
target: Praeterea, Lumian hanc occasionem adhibere voluit ut observarit quid subiecto eveniret, si unum eorum fragmentorum fati arriperet sine fata commutando aut mortem directe inferendo.

source: This was not mentioned in the mystical knowledge possessed by a Fate Appropriator. The only thing Lumian knew for certain was that the past would not change, and what had already transpired would remain unchanged.
target: Hoc non memoratum fuit in scientia mystica, quam Fato Appropiantore haberet, opusque unum quod Lumian certo scivit erat: praeteritum non mutaretur, et quae iam gesta erant, immutata manerent.

source: Initially, Lumian had wanted to inquire further about the Mirror People who maintained contact with Moran Avigny and their positions. However, the urgency of the situation led him to postpone this matter to the spirit channeling part. In any case, it wasn’t particularly crucial.
target: Initio, Lumian ulteriora indagare voluerat de Populo Speculi, qui cum Moran Avigny contactum habebat, et de locis eorum. Tamen, urgentes rei causae eum ad hanc rem in partem canalizationis spiritus differendam detulerunt. Quocumque modo, non valde necessarium erat.

source: From Lumian’s perspective, it was more important to know the identities of the Mirror People who had infiltrated the Demoness Sect and who had gone to Lenburg in search of an item. However, Moran Avigny clearly had no knowledge of this.
target: Ex prospectu Lumiani, magis grave erat cognoscere identitates Hominum Speculi qui Sectam Demonissæ infiltraverunt et ad Lenburg item quaerendum perrexerunt. Sed Moran Avigny hujus rei plane ignarus erat.

source: Lumian suspected that the Mirror People who had gone to Lenburg were looking for clues about 0-01. After all, based on the information, this item likely had a close connection to Blood Emperor Alista Tudor. The method of sealing it was quite similar to sealing Fourth Epoch Trier. It might be of great significance to the Mirror People from the special mirror world in Fourth Epoch Trier.
target: Lumian suspicabatur Homines Speculi, qui ad Lenburg ierant, quaerere indicia de 0-01. Nam ex informationibus evenit hoc artefactum fortasse arcte coniunctum esse cum Imperatore Sanguineo Alista Tudor; et modus sigillandi eius valde similis erat modo sigillandi Trier Quarti Æpoci. Id fortasse magni momenti fuit pro Hominibus Speculi ex mundo speculi specialis Trier Quarti Æpoci.

source: Lumian extended his right palm and pressed it against Moran Avigny from a distance.
target: Lumian dextram manum protulit et, a longe, eam contra Moran Avigny premuit.

source: His blue eyes rapidly turned silver-black.
target: Oculi eius caerulei celeriter in nigrum argenteum conversi sunt.

source: Moran Avigny was perplexed by Lumian’s strange behavior.
target: Moran Avigny mores insolitos Lumiani perplexus erat.

source: Although he possessed the strength of a Sequence 5, he had been actively involved in politics for the past decade or so.
target: Quamquam vires Sequentiae V possidebat, iam per decem annos in rebus politicis active versatus erat.

source: He maintained a certain distance from the mysticism domain and the emerging cults.
target: Ab regno mysticarum scientiarum et cultibus emergentibus aliquam distantiam servabat.

source: This was particularly true after becoming the Minister of Industry.
target: Hoc praecipue verum erat postquam factus est Minister Industriae.

source: He relied entirely on the connections within the Mirror People and the Brokers of the School of Truth to acquire the knowledge, information, and items he desired.
target: Confidebat omnino in nexibus intra Populum Speculi et negotiatores Scholae Veritatis ad scientiam, informationem, et res quas cupiebat adquirendas.

source: Direct contact with wild Beyonders was uncommon, so he naturally couldn’t discern Lumian’s intentions.
target: Contactus directus cum feris Beyonders rarus erat; ideo naturaliter Lumian consilia eius discernere non poterat.

source: He only instinctively believed that Lumian had ulterior motives and wasn’t simply acting.
target: Ipse solum instinctu credidit Lumian ulteriora propositum habere et non rem simpliciter agere.

source: Lumian’s right palm “touched” the mercury illusory river corresponding to Moran Avigny.
target: Palma dextra Lumiani attigit flumen mercurii illusorii, quod ad Moran Avigny correspondebat.

source: The life of the Mirror Person flashed before his eyes, and various fate fragments surged along the river.
target: Vita Personae Speculi coram oculis eius fulguravit, et varia fragmenta fati per flumen celeriter fluxerunt.

source: Lumian couldn’t discern them in detail. Seizing the brief span of two to three seconds, he focused on observing two fate fragments.
target: Lumian ea subtiliter distinguere non potuit; duobus ad trium secundorum brevi spatio captis, duo fragmenta fati observare intendit.

source: One fate fragment depicted how Moran Avigny remotely instructed the School of Truth’s Overseer to perform a ritual through the mirror, establishing a connection with the Mirror Roselle Gustav.
target: Unum fragmentum fati depinxit quomodo Moran Avigny a longe Supervisorem Scholae Veritatis iuberet ut per speculum ritum celebreretur, nexum efficiens cum Roselle Gustav Speculi.

source: The other aspect was how this Mirror Person came into being.
target: Alia vero pars erat quomodo haec Persona Speculi exsistere coepisset.

source: In the previous fate segment, Lumian witnessed Moran Avigny stuffing a classic silver mirror into his makeup mirror and lending it to the Overseer.
target: In segmento fati praeterito, Lumian conspectus est Moran Avigny speculum classicum argenteum in speculum faciei suae inserere et illud Supervisori tradidisse.

source: At the source of the mercury river of fate, the 17- or 18-year-old Mirror Moran Avigny swiftly materialized in the dark and cold room, his expression naturally sinister.
target: Apud fontem fluminis mercurii fati, Moran Avigny Speculi, annos XVII vel XVIII natus, celeriter in conclavi obscuro et frigido apparuit, vultu naturaliter malevolenti.

source: The classic silver mirror bears a striking resemblance to the one Franca found at the overflow of corruption in the mirror world. She had relied on the latter to enter Fourth Epoch Trier during Operation Hostel… Could such a mirror be closely tied to the Mirror People?
target: Speculum classicum argenteum notabiliter simile est illi, quod Franca in inundatione corruptionis in mundo speculi invenit. Illo confugerat ut in Trier Quarti Æpoci, per Operationem Hostel, intraret… Num tale speculum arcte coniungi possit cum Populo Speculi?

source: Didn’t Moran Avigny say that the descendants of the Tamara family naturally have a corresponding Mirror Person?
target: Nonne dixit Moran Avigny quod posteritas familiae Tamarae naturaliter habeat personam speculi correspondentem?

source: Why wasn’t he a baby when he was born as a Mirror Person?
target: Cur non infans erat, cum ut Persona Speculi natus esset?

source: The descendants of the Tamara family must reach a certain age or have done something specific to produce the corresponding Mirror People?
target: Nonne posteritas familiae Tamarae certam aetatis finem attingere debet aut aliquid specificum facienda est, ut personae speculi correspondentis producantur?

source: He doesn’t seem to understand what’s going on either…
target: Ille parum videtur intellegere quid agatur…

source: As these thoughts raced through his mind, Lumian didn’t allow the Fate Appropriation attempt to end naturally and result in failure.
target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem eius volitabant, Lumian non permisit experimentum appropriationis fati naturaliter finiri et in defectum degere.

source: He seized the moment and grasped a fate fragment in his right hand.
target: Ille momentum arripuit et fatum fragmentum in manu dextra apprehendit.

source: Through the spew of his spirituality, he slowly extracted the abnormally heavy target from the mercury-colored illusory river.
target: Per effusum spiritualitatis suae, lente extraxit obiectum insolitè grave ex flumine mercurii illusorii.

source: The fate fragment corresponded to the scene of Moran Avigny’s lust exploding under the Symphony of Hatred.
target: Fragmentum fati correspondebat scaenae in qua libidine Moran Avigny sub Symphonia Odii erupta erat.

source: As time passed, Franca and Jenna asked about the other Mirror People to divert Moran Avigny’s attention, and the fate fragment finally left the mercury river.
target: Cum tempus transibat, Franca et Jenna de reliquis Hominibus Speculi quaesiverunt ut attentionem Moran Avigny avertirent, et fragmentum fati denique flumen mercurii reliquit.

source: Consequently, the hole that had appeared was neither filled nor rewoven. Empty chaos occupied it, emitting a thin fog.
target: Consequenter, foramen quod apparuit neque repletum neque restitutum est; chaos vacuum eum occupabat, tenuam nebam efferens.

source: After storing the obtained fate fragments into his Spirit Body, Lumian carefully observed Moran Avigny’s transformation.
target: Postquam fatum fragmenta adeptata in corpus spiritale suum condidit, Lumian diligenter mutationem Moran Avigny inspicuit.

source: As he waited, he muttered inwardly, The fact that we caught Moran Avigny remains unchanged…
target: Dum exspectabat, intus submurmuravit: "Res quod Moran Avigny cepimus immutata manet…"

source: Him drinking the truth serum and being hypnotized remain unchanged…
target: "Eius serum veritatis bibere et hypnotizari immutata manent…"

source: We haven’t forgotten what he just said…
target: Id, quod modo dixerat, non obliti sumus…

source: “Yes, this Fate Appropriation took a total of three minutes. The fate fragment depicting his eruption of lust weighs heavily in Moran Avigny’s entire life. After all, it caused his fate to take a sharp turn for the worse…”
target: "Ita, haec appropriatio fati totum tres minuta tulit.

source: Appropriation requires a distance of 15 meters. Obtaining the target’s blood is unnecessary…
target: Appropriatio spatium quindecim metrorum requirit. Sanguinem obiecti acquirere non necessarium est…

source: While stirring fate and waiting for completion, I can’t attack the target, but I can stay away…
target: Dum fatum agitans et completionem exspectans, obiectum oppugnare non possum, sed ab eo distantiam servare valeo…

source: It’s more convenient to kill him directly. The Appropriation can be completed in a matter of seconds…
target: Commodius est eum directe interficere; Appropriatio paucis secundis perfici potest…

source: As Lumian reviewed, Moran Avigny’s weakened aura gradually filled up, and his face flushed.
target: Dum Lumian recensit, aura Moran Avigny debilitata paulatim repleta est, et vultus eius rubore effusus est.

source: The bloodstains and tears on his face vanished.
target: Sanguinei maculae et lacrimae in facie eius evanuerunt.

source: Yes, there was no eruption of lust, so no severe injuries… Lumian harrumphed as Moran Avigny’s face lit up with pleasant surprise.
target: Ita, eruptio libidinis non evenit, ergo graves laesiones non passa sunt… Lumian sibilavit, cum vultus Moran Avigny iucunda admiratione fulserat.

source: Two beams of white light struck Moran Avigny, knocking him unconscious.
target: Duae radii lucis albae Moran Avigny percuterunt, eum in inscienciam deiecērunt.

source: Simultaneously, Jenna and Franca, who had been closely monitoring Lumian’s movements, aimed their revolvers at the yet-to-collapse Moran Avigny’s head.
target: Simul, Jenna et Franca, quae motus Lumiani arcte observaverant, revolveris in caput Moran Avigny, nondum collapsum, destinaverunt.

source: Amidst the gunshots, the Disciplinary Paladin’s head exploded like blood-colored fireworks.
target: Inter clangores sclopetorum, caput Paladini Disciplinarii quasi ignis artificialis sanguine coloratus explosum est.

source: Lumian didn’t complain about Franca and Jenna not giving him a chance to cull.
target: Lumian non querelavit de Franca et Jenna quod ei occasionem ad caedem non dederunt.

source: He didn’t want to waste his spirituality on Culling.
target: Non voluit spiritualitatem suam in caedem terere.

source: When he appeared at the last moment and used the Symphony of Hatred to shatter Moran Avigny’s remaining Mirror Substitution and capture him, he felt as if the potion had digested somewhat due to the successful cull.
target: Cum ad ultimum momentum apparuisset et Symphonia Odii uti coepisset ad stridentem reliquam speculi substitutionem Moran Avigny frangendam atque eum capiendum, sensit quasi potionem propter felicem caedem aliquantulum digerisse.

source: Thud!
target: Tum!

source: Moran Avigny’s lifeless body crumpled to the ground, and Franca prepared to channel the spirit.
target: Corpus sine vita Moran Avigny in terram corruit, et Franca ad spiritum evocandum se praeparavit.
